subject: Coordination: VPC / On‑Prem Networking + IAM deep dive for HealthSync

Subject: Coordination: VPC / On‑Prem Networking + IAM deep dive for HealthSync

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our notes, HealthSync would benefit from a focused technical deep dive on the VPC/on‑prem networking topology and IAM integration for the pilot. Goal: confirm network requirements, firewall/NAT expectations, and SSO/Kerberos/SAML flows so we can produce a deterministic ops runbook.

Proposed attendees from our side: me (AE, program lead), Marissa (SE — networking + deployment), Monica (security/compliance). Would you also include the HealthSync infra engineer and your procurement contact so we can align on timelines and minimal SCA/PO requirements?

Suggested slots (PT):
- Thu Apr 22, 10:00–11:00am
- Fri Apr 23, 2:00–3:00pm
- Mon Apr 26, 9:00–10:00am

What works best for your team? I can send a calendar invite with an agenda and a short prep pack (network sketch + checklist).

Thanks —
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Rishi —

Thanks. We should include Priya (Infra Eng lead) and our procurement mailbox. Priya mentioned she’s flexible next week but blocked Wed morning for oncall. Of the slots you suggested, Fri Apr 23 2–3pm PT looks good for Priya and me.

Attendees from HealthSync: Priya Anand (Infra), me (product), Aaditya Shah (network engineer — will invite), procurement@healthsync.com (contract/PO). Alex Turner (our third‑party SI) will also join to validate the proposed firewall/NAT changes.

One ask: can your SE bring a brief sample network diagram for an on‑prem gateway config and list of required ports and IP ranges? That will speed alignment. Also share your security checklist so procurement can preemptively review for PII/data handling flags.

Sanjay
Director, Product — HealthSync

On attachments: please include the checklist and any sample diagrams.

Hi Priya / Sanjay —

Great — Fri 23 Apr 2–3pm PT works on my side. I’ll prepare:
- A concise network sketch for an on‑prem gateway + NAT traversal pattern (PNG)
- Required port/IP list for both pilot and scaled deployment
- SSO/IAM patterns we recommend (SAML 2.0 IdP flow + token lifetime guidance)

Action items for the meeting:
1) HealthSync to confirm the public egress IP NAT behavior for your co‑located datacenter (static vs ephemeral).
2) HealthSync to provide the current IdP metadata (SAML) or SSO provider details.
3) Procurement to flag contract timeline constraints (PO lead time, required security evidence).

I’ll attach the draft sketch and a short checklist to the invite. If there are any network diagrams already (even hand sketches), send them over so I can annotate.

Thanks —
Marissa
